classification.difficultyReason: Read strict sign intervals directly from three supplied parabolas with labelled intercepts.

content.prompt: Write down the values of $x$ for which each parabola is:

spec.description: Unfilled upward parabola with labelled roots −1 and 1, y-intercept −1, positive axis arrows and arrows at both curve ends. No grid.
spec.answerVisibility: The graph and intercept labels are permanent givens; response intervals appear only in answers.

answer.worked: The curve lies below the $x$-axis between its intercepts at $-1$ and $1$. Hence $-1<x<1$.
The curve lies above the $x$-axis to the left of $-1$ and to the right of $1$. Hence $x<-1$ or $x>1$.

spec.description: Unfilled upward parabola with roots 2 and 5, y-intercept 10, positive axis arrows and arrows at both curve ends. No grid.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph only; no solution intervals are marked.

answer.worked: The curve lies below the $x$-axis between the intercepts at $2$ and $5$. Hence $2<x<5$.
The curve lies above the $x$-axis outside the two intercepts. Hence $x<2$ or $x>5$.

spec.description: Unfilled downward parabola with roots −2 and 1, y-intercept 2, positive axis arrows and arrows at both curve ends. No grid.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph only; no solution intervals are marked.

answer.worked: The downward-opening curve lies below the $x$-axis outside its intercepts at $-2$ and $1$. Hence $x<-2$ or $x>1$.
The curve lies above the $x$-axis between its intercepts. Hence $-2<x<1$.
